name: Alice

reviews.comment: Alice is an exceptional teacher! Her lessons are engaging, well-structured, and she adapts perfectly to my learning pace.
My English improved drastically in just 2 months. Highly recommend!

lesson_info: I work with students who want to develop their English language skills for professional or academic purposes.
experience: I have 7 years of experience teaching English and French to students of all levels. I hold a CELTA certificate and a Master's degree in Linguistics.

name: Marcus

reviews.comment: Marcus has an incredible ability to explain complex grammar in simple ways. Best German teacher I've had!
Very professional and patient. Lessons are always well-prepared.

lesson_info: My lessons focus on conversational fluency and real-world language use. I tailor each session to your specific goals.
experience: Native German speaker with 5 years of teaching experience. I specialize in helping B1+ students reach advanced fluency.

name: Sofia

reviews.comment: Sofia is absolutely wonderful! She makes learning Spanish so fun and natural. I went from zero to conversational in 3 months.
Incredibly patient and encouraging. Her passion for the language is contagious!

lesson_info: I create a comfortable, immersive environment where you learn Spanish or Portuguese naturally through real conversations.
experience: Born in Madrid, I have been teaching Spanish for 9 years. I also teach European and Brazilian Portuguese with native-level proficiency.

name: Yuki

reviews.comment: Yuki made Japanese feel approachable from day one. The structured approach to Hiragana and Kanji is brilliant.
Amazing teacher! Very methodical, clear, and always encouraging.

lesson_info: I guide beginners through the foundations of Japanese writing systems and build real conversation skills step by step.
experience: Tokyo-born teacher with a degree in Education. I've taught Japanese to over 300 international students over 6 years.

name: Lena

reviews.comment: Lena is incredibly patient with beginners. She makes sure you understand before moving forward.
Great lessons. Clear explanations and very structured approach.

lesson_info: Perfect for complete beginners who want a solid foundation in German or French before moving to more advanced levels.
experience: Certified language teacher from Berlin with 4 years of experience. I have a special passion for helping absolute beginners find their confidence.

name: Arjun

reviews.comment: Arjun helped me prepare for IELTS and I scored 8.0! His methodology is effective and focused.
Excellent teacher for advanced English. He pushed me to refine my academic writing significantly.

lesson_info: I specialize in advanced English for professionals and students aiming for IELTS, TOEFL, or academic writing excellence.
experience: MA in English Literature from Oxford. 8 years of teaching experience with a focus on advanced learners and exam preparation.

name: Camille

reviews.comment: Camille's approach to teaching French is truly unique. She incorporates French cinema and music into lessons.
I love learning French with Camille! She makes every lesson feel like a cultural journey.

lesson_info: My lessons combine language with culture — film, music, cuisine. You learn French and fall in love with France at the same time.
experience: Parisian French teacher with 6 years of experience. I also teach conversational Italian as a native bilingual speaker.

name: Dmitri

reviews.comment: Dmitri made the Cyrillic alphabet seem easy! His systematic approach really works.
Very knowledgeable and patient teacher. My Russian improved a lot.

lesson_info: I take students from zero to conversational Russian with a focus on practical everyday language and grammar clarity.
experience: Moscow-born linguist with a degree in Russian philology. 5 years of teaching Russian as a foreign language online.

name: Mei

reviews.comment: Mei is phenomenal! Learning Mandarin tones seemed impossible until I met her. She has a special technique.
Best Mandarin teacher. Incredibly structured and motivating!

lesson_info: I teach Mandarin with a focus on practical communication, tones mastery, and HSK exam preparation.
experience: Native Mandarin speaker from Shanghai with a TESOL certification. 7 years teaching Chinese to international students.

name: Khalid

reviews.comment: Khalid made Arabic script approachable from the first lesson. Very encouraging and structured.
Excellent teaching style. He explains concepts clearly and provides great cultural context.

lesson_info: I teach Modern Standard Arabic and Egyptian dialect with a focus on real conversational use and script mastery.
experience: Arabic linguist from Cairo with 6 years of teaching experience. I specialize in making Arabic accessible for complete beginners.

name: Ingrid

reviews.comment: Ingrid's lessons are so well-organized. Swedish grammar finally makes sense to me!
Very professional and friendly. I love how she incorporates Scandinavian culture into lessons.

lesson_info: I teach Swedish and Norwegian to learners interested in Scandinavian culture, work, or relocation.
experience: Stockholm-based language teacher with linguistics degree. 4 years teaching Swedish and Norwegian to professionals relocating to Scandinavia.

name: Fatima

reviews.comment: Fatima's advanced Arabic classes pushed my fluency to a whole new level. Exceptional teacher.
She also teaches French at a native level. Brilliant multilingual teacher!

lesson_info: My advanced Arabic and French courses focus on professional communication, literature, and diplomatic language use.
experience: Multilingual teacher from Casablanca. PhD candidate in Arabic linguistics. 8 years of experience in advanced language instruction.
